root_cause: On payments-db-01 in prod the data volume hit 100 percent because WAL archives and a base backup shared the Postgres disk. Writes failed with No space left on device during the settlement batch.
fix: Deleted expired WAL archives older than the last base backup, ran a checkpoint, and card-charge writes succeeded again.

root_cause: Staging host payments-db-03 filled during a replay drill because archive_cleanup was left disabled on the staging volume. The staging data disk reported No space left on device, separate from the prod settlement outage.
fix: Enabled archive_cleanup on the staging replica and moved the replay dump to object storage.

root_cause: The payments db in prod timed out because a leaked transaction held sessions until the connection pool was exhausted on payments-db-01. Checkout could not charge cards.
fix: Cancelled idle-in-transaction backends and restarted the payments pool so new checkouts could borrow a session.

root_cause: A load test against staging payments-db-03 opened one session per virtual user and never returned them. The staging pool maxed out while prod stayed healthy.
fix: Capped the load-test client and recycled the staging pooler.

root_cause: checkout-api-01 in prod pegged the CPU during price calculations after a promo-math change recomputed every cart line. The storefront was compute bound.
fix: Rolled back the price-rule change and CPU fell under 60 percent.

root_cause: Staging checkout-api-03 ran a synthetic promo benchmark that pinned one core. Production checkout-api-01 was not affected.
fix: Stopped the staging benchmark job.

root_cause: dns-01 in prod served NXDOMAIN for internal names after a bad zone serial dropped checkout.internal. Pods could not resolve names.
fix: Restored the known-good zone, bumped the serial, and dig succeeded.

root_cause: Staging resolver dns-03 was pointed at an empty stub zone during a lab exercise. Prod dns-01 kept answering.
fix: Repointed the staging resolver at the staging zone file.

root_cause: worker-01 in prod entered a crashloop because the deploy mounted an empty config file and the async job pod exited on the missing key.
fix: Rolled back the worker image, restored the config map, and the restart count returned to zero.

root_cause: Staging worker-03 crashlooped after a typo in a staging-only feature flag file. The prod worker config was untouched.
fix: Corrected the staging flag file and the pod stayed up.

root_cause: edge-01 in prod served an expired tls certificate. Browsers reported the certificate date is past and handshakes failed.
fix: Installed the renewed certificate and reloaded the public proxy.

root_cause: The staging proxy edge-03 used a short-lived lab certificate that lapsed over the weekend. Prod edge-01 had already been renewed.
fix: Issued a new staging certificate for edge-03.

root_cause: billing-01 in prod leaked memory because the invoice renderer cached every PDF in a global map. RSS never returned to the heap baseline.
fix: Shipped a bounded PDF cache and restarted billing-api.

root_cause: Staging billing-02 retained debug invoice payloads for a profiler session. Prod billing-01 was already on the bounded cache.
fix: Turned off the staging profiler and restarted billing-02.

root_cause: checkout-api-01 in prod saw network latency on downstream calls to inventory. A congested hop made those calls sluggish while the storefront CPU stayed idle.
fix: Shifted checkout traffic off the congested path and dependency latency returned to baseline.

root_cause: Staging checkout-api-03 crossed a bandwidth-limited lab link during a failover test. Prod checkout-api-01 was on the healthy path.
fix: Ended the failover test and staging latency dropped.

root_cause: kafka-01 in prod fell behind on the payments topic. A slow handler stopped the consumer group from committing offsets, so consumer lag climbed.
fix: Restarted the stalled consumers and offsets began to advance.

root_cause: Staging kafka-03 lagged because a test consumer paused on a poison message in a scratch topic. The prod payments group was current.
fix: Skipped the poison message on the staging group.

root_cause: redis-01 in prod started evicting keys after a new prefix stored full carts without a TTL. Checkout cache misses jumped when maxmemory was reached.
fix: Deleted the unbounded prefix, set TTLs, and evictions stopped.

root_cause: Staging redis-03 was sized to a tiny maxmemory for a class and evicted demo keys. Prod redis-01 was below its memory ceiling.
fix: Raised the staging maxmemory for the class and left prod unchanged.

root_cause: edge-01 in prod returned upstream 5xx for checkout because two targets were marked up while still booting. Clients saw server errors after a successful tls handshake.
fix: Drained the booting upstreams until readiness passed and the 5xx rate fell.

root_cause: Staging edge-03 pointed at a checkout build that exited on purpose for a chaos drill. Prod edge-01 kept serving ready targets.
fix: Ended the chaos drill and staging health checks went green.

root_cause: auth-01 in prod presented a certificate whose name did not match the hostname. Login failed tls because the cert name was wrong, and the date was still valid.
fix: Installed the prod certificate that lists auth-01 and reloaded auth-service.

root_cause: Staging auth-03 served a certificate for auth.lab.internal during a name-rotation rehearsal. Prod auth-01 already had the matching name.
fix: Restored the staging hostname on the auth-03 certificate.

root_cause: payments-db-02 in us-west-2 applied WAL several minutes behind the primary after a long analytics transaction.
fix: Cancelled the analytics transaction and lag caught up.

root_cause: search-01 ran a leading-wildcard query that scanned the whole product index.
fix: Rejected leading wildcards and added a trigram field.

root_cause: notify-01 waited on a partner endpoint that never acknowledged receipt.
fix: Shortened the webhook timeout and queued retries.

root_cause: The nightly inventory snapshot on inventory-01 lost its object-storage credential.
fix: Rotated the backup credential and reran the snapshot.

root_cause: kafka-02 drifted four seconds from NTP and started rejecting produce requests.
fix: Stepped the clock back to NTP and restarted the broker.

root_cause: redis-02 was killed by the cgroup after a one-off key import ignored maxmemory.
fix: Restored the maxmemory setting and reloaded the replica from redis-01.

root_cause: worker-02 paused consumers during a deploy window and the job queue depth tripled.
fix: Resumed consumers and scaled worker-02 by one replica until the depth fell.

root_cause: A mobile retry storm tripped the login rate limit on auth-02.
fix: Raised the burst for an hour and shipped client backoff.

root_cause: edge-04 in eu-west-1 saw 3 percent packet loss on the peering link.
fix: Shifted EU traffic to edge-01 until the peer stabilized.

root_cause: A dev deploy of billing-03 failed its smoke test and the pipeline rolled it back.
fix: Fixed the smoke fixture and redeployed the dev build.

root_cause: dns-02 timed out on upstream recursion because the EU forwarder was unreachable.
fix: Pointed dns-02 at the secondary forwarder.

root_cause: search-03 stopped consuming product updates after a staging reindex lock was left in place.
fix: Cleared the lock and the staging index caught up.

root_cause: inventory-02 ran out of inodes because a debug logger created one file per request.
fix: Deleted the debug files and rotated the logger.

root_cause: notify-02 retried a dead staging webhook with no backoff and saturated the worker.
fix: Added jittered backoff on the staging notifier.

root_cause: payments-db-05 in eu-west-1 stalled readers during a huge checkpoint after a long bulk load.
fix: Spread checkpoints with a shorter timeout and reran the bulk load in smaller batches.

root_cause: checkout-api-04 in dev served an unfinished discount path because a flag defaulted to on.
fix: Set the flag default to off and redeployed the dev checkout.
